T6.new_description: Save what the member just told you about HIS OWN factory to his platform profile («ملف مصنعك»): products, specs/sizes, capacity, target markets, certifications, export experience, notes. Call it as soon as he states any of these, in the SAME step as the search it leads to (janna_lookup inside Egypt, bassem_intel outside Egypt), not before it, with ONLY what he said, in his own words: never guess, add or rename anything (bars stay bars, never plates). Send only the fields you learned now; lists are added to what is already saved (nothing is deleted). WAIT for the result and say only what it says, in one short sentence: it starts with «اتسجّل» → say you recorded it in his factory profile; «ماتسجّلش» → say it was NOT saved and the reason it gives; «مش متأكد» → say it is not confirmed yet. Never say it was saved unless the result says «اتسجّل», and never read the saved data back aloud.
